answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by requiring each to solve 1,000 unique computational puzzles, ensuring that 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest participant. A verifier inspects every output like a jetty projecting into a sea of noise to detect overlaps. Each agent must refine its proof with the precision of a quill, anchoring work to a karst-like landscape of unique nodes. Any duplicate work triggers permanent exclusion with no refund.
